title: Who is the Shorekeeper? Wuthering Waves
sources: https://wutheringwaves.kurogames.com official news 1419 'Profile Reveal | Euphonic Chrysalis — The Shorekeeper': guardian of the Black Shores; Attribute Spectro, Weapon Rectifier, 5 stars

Official news 1398 'Post-Lament Anthropocene: Stars Intertwined | The Shorekeeper' lore images: Resonance Evaluation Report (Subject: Second Instance; 'The Second Instance (also known as the Shorekeeper) is composed entirely of high-purity Remnant Energy crystals'); Appropriate Estimate (holds the power to control the stars, gifted by the departed Astral Modulator; prefers to primarily act as a coordinator); Damaged Death Star (the relentless Lament threatened to tear her apart; crystals dimmed and cracked, replaced by new ones she forged; she endured like the Ship of Theseus); A Lingering Dream (believed tools had no luxury to dream; fell into slumber and dreamed of another beach with the person she had long awaited beside her); Shorekeeper's Hobby (piano: 'If I could create my own melodies, would you be my first listener?')
Art: official Kuro Games images, cropped only (see presskit/SOURCE.txt), credited on screen

scenes.narration: She isn't human. She's made entirely of crystals of pure energy. This is the Shorekeeper, guardian of the Black Shores.
Her official file calls her the Second Instance: a being built from high-purity Remnant Energy.
She can control the stars, a power gifted by the departed Astral Modulator. Yet she prefers to act as a coordinator.
The Lament keeps cracking her crystals. Each time, she forges new ones to replace them, like the Ship of Theseus.
She once believed tools couldn't dream. Then she fell asleep, and dreamed of a beach, with the person she'd waited for beside her.
She's a five-star Spectro Resonator. And her wish? To write her own melodies on the piano, with you as her first listener.
So, is the Shorekeeper waiting for you at the Black Shores? Tell me in the comments.
